defs.def: the top part of your legs that forms a flat surface when you are sitting down （坐着时的）大腿部

ex.s: Picture this: my grandson sitting on my lap as I hold the book in front so he can see the pictures.
ex.t: 想象一下：我的孙子坐在我腿上，我把书举在他面前让他看到图片。

ex.s: Recently，I took a trip home by train．I got a seat opposite a middle-aged man with sharp eyes，who kept____1____a young woman in a window seat with a little boy on her lap．The woman's eye fell on the man's face，and she immediately looked down and____2____her scarf．
ex.t: 最近，我乘火车回家。我坐在一位目光锐利的中年男子对面，他一直___1___一位坐在靠窗座位、腿上抱着小男孩的年轻女子。女子的目光落在男子脸上，立刻低下头___2___自己的围巾。

ex.s: I was sitting in my room with my cat, Smarrie, on my lap, when the roof just flew off.
ex.t: 我当时正坐在房间里，我的猫斯玛莉趴在我腿上，这时屋顶突然飞掉了。

ex.s: Instead, lay the child face down on your lap with the head lower than the rest of his body, and then give firm slaps to his upper back until he can breathe again.
ex.t: 相反，把孩子面朝下放在你的大腿上，头部低于身体其他部分，然后用力拍打他的上背部，直到他能再次呼吸。

ex.s: When the check came, I hurried over to Mama's and put it in her lap.
ex.t: 账单来了，我赶紧跑到妈妈身边，把它放在她腿上。

defs.def: one journey from the beginning to the end of a track used for running, etc. （跑道等的）一圈

ex.s: After that, she tried to see if she could complete her first lap.
ex.t: 第三年，我发现处理了数千颗种子后，我只得到了一株可用于实验的植物。

ex.s: One lap turned into two, then three, then four.
ex.t: 到第四年，我对成功的渴望压过了对独立的渴望。

ex.s: The train moved on．The little boy was ____5____ awake on his mother's lap，but the woman dropped off to sleep．A moment later，he began to____6____the half-open window—one leg went over it．The man jumped up and ____7____the child just before he fell out．
ex.t: 火车继续前行。小男孩___5___醒着躺在母亲腿上，但女人睡着了。片刻后，他开始___6___那半开的车窗——一条腿已经跨了过去。男子跳起来，在孩子掉出去前___7___了他。

defs.def: a section of a journey, or of a piece of work, etc. （行程或工作等中的）一段，环节
to touch sth gently and regularly, often making a soft sound 水
to drink sth with quick movements of the tongue 动物
to pass another runner on a track who is one or more laps behind you 赛跑

ex.s: In my first P.E. class, the teacher required us to run laps and then hit a softball.
ex.t: 在我的第一节体育课上，老师要求我们跑步，然后打垒球。

defs.def: to accept or receive sth with great enjoyment, without thinking about whether it is good, true or sincere （不加考虑地）乐于接受

ex.s: Then she sits in Oliver’s lap, puts her arms around his neck and kisses him on the cheek.
ex.t: 然后她坐在奥利弗的腿上，搂住他的脖子，亲吻了他的脸颊。

ex.s: Granny and I made sugar biscuits, stuffed the turkey and then I sat on my granny's lap and we sang Christmas songs.
ex.t: 奶奶和我做了糖饼干，给火鸡填了馅，然后我坐在奶奶腿上，一起唱了圣诞歌。

defs.def: to drink all of sth with great enjoyment 开怀畅饮
